summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of AP Pickleball Club landing site. Verified hero (paddle ornament + auto slider + 3 dots), homepage section order (Reviews 01 → Branches 02 → Booking 03 → Instagram 04 → Ventures 05), Booking section badges, Branches photo cards + Contact Branch → /contact routing, Instagram profile cards, Navbar Contact Us + Book a Court, /contact page (all 4 phone numbers, Open 24×7, no form), /bollywood-vibes and /tcd-cafe WhatsApp CTA hrefs, cross-route section-link scroll (Reviews from /contact → /#reviews with scrollY≈1183), scroll-reset on route change (scrollY=0 after nav to /contact), footer links, and mobile hamburger menu open/close + link navigation. No console errors or page errors on any route.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow on mobile — documentElement.scrollWidth=464 vs innerWidth=390 (~74px overflow). Paddle+ball ornament extends beyond the right edge causing a horizontal scrollbar on mobile. Consider clipping the hero container with overflow-x-hidden or constraining paddle size/translation on <sm breakpoints.

issues: Both 'Contact Us' and 'Book a Court' pill buttons render inline in the top bar next to the hamburger, making the header crowded on small screens. Spec asked for these to live inside the mobile-menu-panel only; consider hiding them from the top bar on <md so the hamburger owns those CTAs.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow caused by hero paddle ornament (add overflow-x:hidden to hero/root or constrain paddle transform on sm breakpoints).
Consider hiding the inline Contact Us / Book a Court pill buttons from the mobile top bar since they are already inside mobile-menu-panel.
critical_code_review_comments: Lenis warning logged on every page: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute'. Add position:relative to the Lenis wrapper container to silence and ensure correct scroll offset calculation.
Mobile hero overflow indicates paddle ornament is positioned/scaled without responsive constraint — good candidate for a sm: variant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested data-testids exist and work: hero-paddle, hero-slider, hero-slide-dot-0/1/2, booking-appstore-badge (App Store URL), booking-playstore-badge (Play Store URL), branch-photo-thaltej/gandhinagar, branch-contact-thaltej (→/contact), insta-profile-card-thaltej/gandhinagar, nav-contact-btn, mobile-menu-button, mobile-menu-panel, bv-download-packages-btn (wa.me), tcd-download-menu-btn (wa.me), footer-contact-link, footer-bollywood-link, footer-tcd-link. All 4 phones present on /contact and no <form> on /contact (correct). Section order confirmed via chapter numbers in DOM. Only remaining issue is mobile horizontal overflow from paddle ornament.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: On 390px viewport document.scrollWidth reports 464. Hero paddle ornament (data-testid=hero-paddle) is absolutely positioned/translated to the right of the hero text and its bounding box extends past the viewport right edge. Fix: wrap hero root with overflow-x-hidden OR add a media-query/tailwind sm: variant that reduces the paddle's translateX/scale on mobile.
